tools.name: compare_texas_electricity_plans
tools.description: This tool ranks the Texas electricity plans at a ZIP code by what each would cost over a year at the person's own monthly kWh (not the 1,000 kWh figure plan ads quote). Free, no account. No electricity company pays ElectricityFinder (Odigital LLC, PUCT broker BR260062); it is paid only by subscriber

tools.name: how_to_get_my_usage
tools.description: How a Texas household gets 12 months of electricity usage (kWh) for compare_texas_electricity_plans: Smart Meter Texas download, bills, or one typical month. Also explains when monthly numbers are enough.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Sends feedback to the people who run ElectricityFinder: a price or plan that looks wrong, an answer that was confusing, a missing feature, or an error. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "compare_texas_electricity_plans" is 2404 chars, far longer than this server's median (362). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
